---
title: "Advice sheets"
---

Whether the advice sheet of each stock links to its TAF code, and whether the link is right.

The published code of a stock is in a public repository in [ices-advice](https://github.com/ices-advice), named for the year and the stock, so that is where an advice sheet should link to. The repositories in [ices-taf](https://github.com/ices-taf) are where the work is done, and most are private: a link to one is a mistake, as readers of the advice cannot open it.

The advice sheets are those from 2024 on in the [ICES library](https://ices-library.figshare.com), read once a week. Where the advice for a stock was replaced during the year, the latest sheet is used.

::: {.callout-tip icon=false}
Admins can rerun the update action here: [UpdateAdvice](https://github.com/ices-eg/wg_WGTAFGOV/actions/workflows/update-advice.yml). Choose **Run workflow**; the new advice sheets appear on this page after the site is next built.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_plot.R")

sheets <- read.csv("../_taf/site/data/advice-sheets.csv")

# what was found, with the problems first
statuses <- c(
  "Links to ices-taf" = "The link is to a repository in ices-taf, which readers cannot open.",
  "Links elsewhere" = "The link is to a repository in another organisation.",
  "Wrong repository" = "The link is not to the repository of the stock and year: it is to another year or stock, or the name is mistyped.",
  "Repository not public" = "The link is to the repository of the stock and year, but it does not exist or is private.",
  "Malformed link" = "The link has something in it that should not be there, so may not work.",
  "Repository not linked" = "There is a repository in ices-advice for the stock and year, but the advice sheet does not link to it.",
  "OK" = "The link is to the public repository in ices-advice for the stock and year.",
  "No link" = "The advice sheet has no link to GitHub, and there is no repository in ices-advice.",
  "Not checked" = "The advice sheet has not been looked at yet."
)
colours <- c(
  "Links to ices-taf" = "#d03b3b", "Links elsewhere" = "#6250d6", "Wrong repository" = "#eda100",
  "Repository not public" = "#ec835a", "Malformed link" = "#e87ba4", "Repository not linked" = "#8a8984",
  "OK" = "#3987e5", "No link" = "#e3e2dd", "Not checked" = "#f4f3f0"
)
problems <- setdiff(names(statuses), c("OK", "No link", "Not checked"))
sheets$status <- factor(sheets$status, names(statuses))
found <- levels(droplevels(sheets$status))

latest <- sheets[sheets$year == max(sheets$year), ]
```

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## Current status

Of the `r nrow(sheets)` advice sheets since `r min(sheets$year)`, **`r sum(sheets$status == "OK")` link to the published code** of their stock. **`r sum(sheets$status %in% problems)` have a problem with the link**, of which `r sum(sheets$status == "Links to ices-taf")` link to ices-taf by mistake. In `r max(sheets$year)`, `r sum(latest$status == "OK")` of the `r nrow(latest)` advice sheets link to the published code and `r sum(latest$status %in% problems)` have a problem.
:::

## Advice sheet TAF link check

The number of advice sheets each year, by what was found.

```{r}
#| echo: false
by_year <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(sheets$status, sheets$year))[found, , drop = FALSE]
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Status = found,
    by_year,
    Total = rowSums(by_year),
    Meaning = unname(statuses[found]),
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(by_year) + 1), "l")
)
```

## Advice sheets by year

The advice sheets with no link, which are most of them, are left out of the chart to begin with: click **No link** in the legend to add them. They are always in the table.

Click a bar to list its advice sheets in the table below. To show them all again, use the button above the table or double-click the chart.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
# the advice sheets, shared by the chart and the table so that clicking a bar
# filters the table
link <- function(url, text) sprintf("<a href=\"%s\">%s</a>", url, htmltools::htmlEscape(text))

# the links as they are written in the advice sheet, each going to the
# address in it
links <- vapply(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(sheets$links), "", sheets$links), " | ", fixed = TRUE), function(x) {
  address <- sub("^.*?((https?://)?(www[.])?github[.]com/)", "\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
  address <- ifelse(grepl("^https?://", address), address, paste0("https://", address))
  paste(link(address, x), collapse = "<br>")
}, "")

# where the repository of the stock is not linked to, "repository" goes to it
status <- as.character(sheets$status)
known <- !is.na(sheets$repository)
unlinked <- known & sheets$status %in% "Repository not linked"
status[unlinked] <- paste(link(sheets$repository[unlinked], "Repository"), "not linked")
wrong <- known & sheets$status %in% "Wrong repository"
status[wrong] <- paste("Wrong", link(sheets$repository[wrong], "repository"))

listed <- data.frame(
  Year = as.character(sheets$year),
  Stock = sheets$stock,
  "Advice sheet" = link(sheets$url, sheets$title),
  Status = status,
  "Link in the advice sheet" = links,
  # not shown: puts the table in the order of the statuses above
  rank = as.numeric(sheets$status),
  check.names = FALSE
)
shared <- crosstalk::SharedData$new(listed)

# the bars: the number of advice sheets by year and status, stacked by hand so
# that a clicked bar is highlighted in place. Each bar carries the keys of its
# advice sheets, which is what links it to the rows of the table.
bars <- aggregate(
  list(key = shared$key()),
  data.frame(Status = sheets$status, Year = listed$Year),
  function(x) I(list(x))
)
bars$n <- lengths(bars$key)
# those with no link are at the top, so that the rest still stand on the axis
# while they are left out
stacked <- c(setdiff(found, "No link"), intersect(found, "No link"))
bars <- bars[order(bars$Year, match(bars$Status, stacked)), ]
bars$base <- ave(bars$n, bars$Year, FUN = function(n) cumsum(n) - n)

p <- plot_ly()
for (status in stacked) {
  p <- p |>
    add_bars(
      data = linked_bars(bars[bars$Status == status, ], shared),
      x = ~Year, y = ~n, base = ~base, name = status,
      # most advice sheets have no link: left out until clicked in the legend
      visible = if (status == "No link") "legendonly" else TRUE,
      marker = list(color = colours[[status]], line = list(color = "white", width = 2)),
      customdata = ~n, hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{customdata} advice sheets"
    )
}
p |>
  taf_layout(
    barmode = "overlay",
    xaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "category ascending"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Advice sheets", rangemode = "nonnegative")
  ) |>
  layout(legend = list(y = -0.12, traceorder = "normal")) |>
  highlight(
    on = "plotly_click", off = "plotly_doubleclick", opacityDim = 0.35,
    selected = attrs_selected(showlegend = FALSE)
  ) |>
  config(doubleClickDelay = 500)
```

## Advice sheets

The advice sheets with a problem are first.

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_all_button(shared, "Show all advice sheets")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# sort by status, in the order above, then the latest year first
DT::datatable(
  shared,
  rownames = FALSE, escape = FALSE,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    order = list(list(5, "asc"), list(0, "desc"), list(1, "asc")),
    columnDefs = list(list(visible = FALSE, targets = 5))
  )
)
```
